sprints.title: Baseline and inherited acceptance
sprints.goal: Make every inherited acceptance obligation executable and establish the project controls.
sprints.deliverables: Frozen source/ABI and case ledger, owners and original-deadline fixtures; project backlog and QA operating contract.
sprints.exitGate: Every inherited case has its original identity/oracle/deadline or a blocking missing-evidence entry; no historical CPU pass is relabeled native.

sprints.title: Product policy and measured budgets
sprints.goal: Freeze what correct and usable behavior means before judging candidate implementations.
sprints.deliverables: Versioned scene/switcher policy, workload budgets, readability matrix and participant usability protocol; isolated layering diagnosis.
sprints.exitGate: Numeric applicable budgets and usability criteria are frozen; Generic replacement-desktop regression fixtures and native diagnosis evidence are retained.

sprints.title: Native host and protocol spikes
sprints.goal: Display a minimal Elm surface through isolated host candidates with a validated transport boundary.
sprints.deliverables: GTK/WebKit and comparative Qt host prototypes; surface/input-region adapters; lossless schema, clock/queue/refusal tables; protected lifecycle harness.
sprints.exitGate: A real native shell surface, passthrough regions and versioned decoder/ABI rejection fixtures pass; no main-desktop activation.

sprints.title: Accelerated and accessible host selection
sprints.goal: Select a host from measured rendering, input and lifecycle evidence.
sprints.deliverables: Hardware webview render probe, separately qualified WebGPU result, hybrid-device ledger, IME and minimal native accessibility/chord probes; host ADR.
sprints.exitGate: Nonsoftware webview composition and measured budgets pass; actual IME/popup/focus/AT route passes; unavailable WebGPU is honestly conditional.

sprints.title: Typed Elm policy and reliable authority
sprints.goal: Implement one receipt-driven path from a pure Elm reducer to validated native effects.
sprints.deliverables: Domain types/replay, bridge sequencing and gap barrier, cancel/deadline/dedup/dependency guards, bounded queues, authenticated session and settings boundary.
sprints.exitGate: Named Quint/fuzz/replay tests and native stale/cancel/Unknown rejection pass; no effect is inferred from send or transport acceptance.

sprints.title: Canonical layering and focus
sprints.goal: Make eligibility, painting, hit testing and focus agree under a committed native policy.
sprints.deliverables: Shared scene transaction, modal/transient constraints, MAX/pin behavior, minimize focus succession, cross-workspace activation, lock/protected capture policy.
sprints.exitGate: Heroic inactive-minimized and Brave MAX regressions, genuine blocker/no-focus cases and scoped workspace races pass with pixel/input receipts.

sprints.title: Taskbar vertical slice
sprints.goal: Ship an isolated selectable Elm taskbar with truthful actions and feedback.
sprints.deliverables: Left layout/catalog/pin/group projection, primary-action table, overflow, pending/refusal/Unknown feedback and AT announcements.
sprints.exitGate: Zero/single/group/active/minimized action fixtures, delayed/refused outcomes and keyboard overflow pass without duplicate effects.

sprints.title: Switcher and shell interaction lifecycle
sprints.goal: Complete native chord handling and usable shell focus scopes.
sprints.deliverables: MRU chord reducer, forward/reverse/cancel/retire fixtures, multi-output projections, focus scopes and subscriptions; proxy/modal handoff contract.
sprints.exitGate: Release-before-open, cancellation, incarnation reuse, native popup changed/same/stale routes and actual taskbar/switcher accessibility pass.

sprints.title: Retained family captures
sprints.goal: Keep authorized preview pixels valid after their source stops.
sprints.deliverables: Opaque lease/fence API, source-stop ownership, frame identity/timestamps, composed-family fidelity and explicit preview states.
sprints.exitGate: Native source-stop and family pixel/fence/capability fixtures pass; historical/live/unavailable labels match actual source state.

sprints.title: Minimize and restore transactions
sprints.goal: Restore correctly within the original deadline using inert proxies and current native authority.
sprints.deliverables: Minimize/seed/live workflows, reversal/cancellation/retirement, native caption/edge integration, live reduced-motion profiles.
sprints.exitGate: Original baseline38/recovery34 and case-34 deadline oracle pass; atomic proxy-to-live handoff and exact normal retirement receipts hold.

sprints.title: Graphics fault and resource qualification
sprints.goal: Survive lock, revocation, output changes and GPU loss without stale pixels or runaway work.
sprints.deliverables: Native preview interoperability, device/allocation failure handling, privacy/unlock, transfer budgets, generation transforms and demand-driven quiescence.
sprints.exitGate: Fault/lock/fence/output cases and whole-tree preview budgets pass; device loss retires invalid storage or exposes unavailable state.

sprints.title: Launcher, menus and system integration
sprints.goal: Deliver complete discoverable application and settings journeys.
sprints.deliverables: Generation-safe search, jump lists, settings/themes entry points, notifications, system adapters, Files integration and first-use help.
sprints.exitGate: Current-query launch/refusal and notification identity cases pass; adapters expose unavailable state; Files semantics and shortcut preferences persist.

sprints.title: Task View, snapping and physical outputs
sprints.goal: Make workspace and output journeys visibly correct and recoverable.
sprints.deliverables: Overview navigation/transfer, snap chooser, exclusive/menu policy, output-removal recovery and physical display acceptance.
sprints.exitGate: Workspace transfer/refusal, scale/rotation/hotplug and active fullscreen/pin/modal policies pass; no invisible focus trap remains.

sprints.title: Accessibility and representative user flows
sprints.goal: Qualify every migrated surface through keyboard, speech, braille and real application flows.
sprints.deliverables: Full semantic control inventory, focus scopes, supported text/reflow themes, IME reruns on actual surfaces and formative usability results.
sprints.exitGate: Every surface passes keyboard/AT and configured usability thresholds; original pin/input/popup/drag and representative app cases have exact receipts.

sprints.title: Reproducible release and recovery
sprints.goal: Build a deployable candidate with independently usable recovery.
sprints.deliverables: Dependency/ABI locks, SBOM/notices, offline build and target matrix, atomic installation/settings migration, restart/suspend/interrupted-upgrade and rollback tooling.
sprints.exitGate: One release tuple is reproducible; restart/resync and offline rollback restore compatible settings; only qualified targets are advertised.

sprints.title: Integrated release qualification
sprints.goal: Produce a concrete release decision from one coherent tuple.
sprints.deliverables: Combined regression and UX ledger, whole-tree performance/power/soak, high-refresh evidence, incident runbook and activation review packet.
sprints.exitGate: All applicable mandatory gates pass with the same source/runtime/ABI tuple; failed/unobserved outcomes block release; authorized activation has rollback receipts.

sprints.title: Optional compositor feasibility
sprints.goal: Decide whether replacing Hyprland is justified by an isolated native prototype.
sprints.deliverables: Substrate/license/maintenance ADR, Wayland/Xwayland protocol matrix and explicit scope/resource decision.
sprints.exitGate: Representative native compatibility evidence and a documented go/no-go decision; a no-go does not block the mandatory shell.

sprints.title: Optional compositor roles and lifecycle
sprints.goal: Prove a minimal native substrate with real application lifecycle.
sprints.deliverables: xdg roles/configure/ack, Xwayland window/focus integration and approved backend skeleton.
sprints.exitGate: Representative native role/lifecycle and legacy X11 fixtures pass in nested sessions.

sprints.title: Optional compositor outputs and seat
sprints.goal: Prove native hardware/input lifecycle independently of Elm timing.
sprints.deliverables: Outputs/modes/leases, input device lifecycle and suspend/resume.
sprints.exitGate: Isolated hotplug and input/output transition fixtures pass without losing ownership.

sprints.title: Optional compositor IME and portals
sprints.goal: Prove text input, capture consent and revocation.
sprints.deliverables: Native IME/text-input and PipeWire/screencopy portal adapters.
sprints.exitGate: Current-focus IME and session-bound portal consent/revocation fixtures pass.

sprints.title: Optional compositor isolation and policy
sprints.goal: Harden native isolation and bounded policy fallback.
sprints.deliverables: Threat-model fixtures, lock/client/buffer isolation and asynchronous Elm policy snapshots.
sprints.exitGate: Malformed clients and stalled frontend cannot bypass lock isolation or native input deadlines.

sprints.title: Optional compositor compatibility qualification
sprints.goal: Qualify all parity and compositor-specific behaviors on the new backend.
sprints.deliverables: New backend release matrix and fresh compatibility receipts.
sprints.exitGate: No Hyprland-only receipt substitutes for a new-compositor gate; all applicable mandatory scenarios rerun.

sprints.title: Optional compositor hardware and cutover
sprints.goal: Prepare a reversible hardware rollout after native acceptance.
sprints.deliverables: Sacrificial hardware qualification and draft-preserving activation/recovery packet.
sprints.exitGate: Hardware acceptance and independently rehearsed rollback pass before any authorized session cutover.
